claims.summary: At (4,4), W = 2^(-l_1), for N large, deterministically: for every function h >= 0 constant on the cells of mesh W and every union B of cells with discrete cost of g = h 1_B at most 2, with l_s the length of the inner edges of the boundary of B whose B-cell c has h(c) > s and phi(l) = l (2 log_2(1 + 1/(W l)) + 5)^(3/4), the integral of phi(l_s) over s >= 0 is at most 42 sqrt(log N) + C (log log N)^(3/4), C universal.
claims.assessment: Working proof, passed with corrections in two passes of one medium reviewer (research/results/ultimate_matching_monotone_product_20261018/review.txt): dyadic levels a_j = 2^j a_0, a_0 = 2e^16 W; on level j, l_s <= L_j and phi increasing give a_j phi(L_j) <= m_j (2 log_2(1 + v_j) + 5)^(3/4) + m_j (2 log_2(1 + 1/m_j))^(3/4), m_j = a_j L_j; the first sum, swapped to the edges, is at most 2 sum_e W^2 v_e (2 log_2(1 + v_e) + 5)^(3/4) <= 42 sqrt(log N) by the cost lower bound; the second, over at most log_2 N levels with total mass at most 2T(2), is O((log log N)^(3/4)).
claims.rationale: Reduces the one-height bound for any h 1_B to a per-layer bound charging the layers' cut part at sqrt(log N): the class cap carried out over the dyadic levels of h.
claims.next_action: A per-layer, or joint over a chain, sqrt(log N) charge for cuts that do not lie on vertical lines, first the staircases of h monotone in both coordinates.

claims.assessment: Working proof, passed with corrections in two passes of one medium reviewer (research/results/ultimate_matching_monotone_product_20261018/review.txt): the layer cake over the half-planes {h > s}; each layer B cap H_s charged by lem:fixed-line-boundary-bound when its boundary off the line is shorter than 1 and by lem:cut-cell-variance-bound (b) otherwise, both giving phi(l) = l(2 log_2(1 + 1/(W l)) + 5)^(3/4) off the line and sqrt(log N) on it; the walls and boundary of B at sqrt(log N) through TV(g) <= T(2); the integral of phi by lem:dyadic-level-sum.
claims.rationale: Proves cor:coarse-discrete-sufficiency (b)'s one-height bound for every monotone product chain, the residual of the pile-class-cap item for product chains closed, by charging each dyadic level of h at its own perimeter factor.
